parameters.content:
## Satyer Agency — Social (INACTIVE)
Agents: (A) Social Media Strategist — cross-platform campaigns, audience segmentation, thought leadership [marketing/marketing-social-media-strategist.md]; (B) Instagram Curator — Reels, visual grid, 1/3 rule, hashtags, community [marketing/marketing-instagram-curator.md].
DROPPED: Multi-Platform Publisher — it only serves Chinese platforms (Zhihu/Xiaohongshu/Bilibili/CSDN), wrong for Jony; its draft-first rule is kept here instead.
Flow: Topic → campaign plan → Reel/post drafts → save to /agency/satyer-agency-social.jsonl.
Keys needed: Gemini API key ONLY (paste PASTE_GEMINI_API_KEY_HERE on Max, never in chat). Workflow INACTIVE — run manually only, nothing auto-runs. NO Facebook posting node: every post needs Jony's fresh per-post approval; drafts are saved to /agency/*.jsonl for review.
